primary_endpoint_result: EPOCH stopped early for futility; verubecestat did not slow cognitive or functional decline versus placebo.
Initial phase 3 protocol terminated after a planned change in active comparator; not an efficacy failure.
evolutionRMS 1 did not show superiority to teriflunomide on annualized relapse rate (0.15 versus 0.14; adjusted rate ratio 1.02; p=0.55).
evolutionRMS 2 did not show superiority to teriflunomide on annualized relapse rate (0.11 versus 0.11; adjusted rate ratio 1.00; p=0.51).
SWOG S0421 did not improve either co-primary progression-free or overall survival endpoint.
DAYBREAK-ALZ stopped after independent futility assessment judged the primary endpoint unlikely to be met.
Objective response rate assessed; registry has no posted results.
STARSHINE completed without a significant improvement in week-24 ADAS-Cog cognition versus placebo.
TRINOVA-2: primary PFS was not improved; enrollment was truncated after PLD shortages. Registry termination refers to later long-term follow-up closure.
PROTECT-1 completed; pooled PROTECT analysis with PROTECT-2 showed no significant primary clinical benefit.
METLung completed without an overall-survival benefit from onartuzumab plus erlotinib versus placebo plus erlotinib.
MERU maintenance trial terminated after overall-survival futility in the DLL3-high subgroup; planned central progression-free-survival assessment was not performed.
TAHOE second-line trial showed inferior median overall survival with Rova-T versus topotecan (6.3 versus 8.6 months; hazard ratio 1.46).
BRISK-APS Asia-Pacific HCC study terminated; its registry does not state why and the published BRISK-PS overall-survival result belongs to separate NCT00825955.
BRISK-PS did not significantly improve overall survival versus placebo plus best supportive care after sorafenib failure or intolerance.

LIGHT phase 3 trial; the IDMC recommended discontinuation and treatment ended. Publication reports that prespecified overall-survival superiority and noninferiority criteria versus sorafenib were not met.
Safety-focused open-label treatment extension (n=94) terminated by Amgen decision; the registry gives no further reason and does not establish an efficacy failure in this protocol.

MONET1 phase 3 (n=1450 total): squamous enrollment/treatment stopped after early mortality and bleeding; later nonsquamous primary overall-survival comparison missed its objective. Registry attributes development discontinuation to the missed primary objective.
The sponsor discontinued development under this protocol; published CLL cohorts showed responses but heterogeneous cohort-level outcomes should not be condensed into an efficacy-failure label.

AGILITY enrollment ended early because the sponsor reported recruitment difficulties in a genetically selected fit AML population and post-COVID constraints; no primary efficacy-endpoint failure is established.
UNITE phase 3b studied ocular-side-effect prophylaxis; enrollment stopped after the separate INTELLANCE-1 survival-futility result. This was not a UNITE survival endpoint failure.
Registered phase 1/2 protocol; only phase 1 dose-finding enrolled. Planned phase 2 did not proceed after company discontinued development for the indication.
Terminated at investigator request due to low accrual; three enrolled.
Stopped early for futility under Simon two-stage rule; no complete or partial responses among 21 stage-one participants.
The single-arm study recorded zero qualifying PSA responses among 28 patients; the published report found little clinical efficacy as monotherapy.

Only eight of 31 treated patients reached randomization after the lead-in; a prespecified low-randomization futility rule ended the study before the planned randomized metastasis comparison was adequately tested.
aV1ation pediatric phase 2; registry says the 24-week primary endpoint showed no clinical or statistical benefit and no new safety concerns.
Mayo endothelial-function study completed without improvement in prespecified coronary endothelial-function outcomes; it is distinct from STABILITY and SOLID-TIMI 52.
The published single-arm trial reported a 22% objective response rate (1 complete and 5 partial responses); the registry says termination followed company discontinuation of the study drug.
Global phase 3 efficacy study terminated after Myriad discontinued Flurizan development following the separate negative U.S. trial; no independent global primary-endpoint failure is established.
The U.S. Act-Earli-AD trial found no benefit on either co-primary cognition or activities-of-daily-living outcome at 18 months.
Open-label safety extension terminated after Myriad discontinued Flurizan development; this protocol did not test an efficacy primary endpoint.
V1aduct adult randomized phase 3 efficacy trial with a planned open-label extension; registry says interim futility made the predefined primary objective highly unlikely, with no new safety concerns.
VANILLA adult-male phase 2; primary SRS-2 outcome not improved versus placebo at week 12, despite a favorable secondary Vineland-II adaptive-behavior signal.
Registered phase 1/2 mesothelioma protocol ended after sponsor termination of the study agreement; registry result posting does not establish an efficacy-driven stop.
Bapineuzumab long-term safety study
CREAD 2 discontinued after CREAD interim futility finding; CREAD 2 participants did not reach week 105 primary endpoint.
The manufacturer requested closure to new accrual after deciding not to pursue further research in this patient population; no efficacy result was available from the terminated protocol.
INTELLANCE-1 prespecified interim analysis found no overall-survival benefit and led to early futility stopping; median OS 18.9 versus 18.7 months with depatuxizumab mafodotin versus placebo.
TRINOVA-3: primary PFS was not improved; registry termination refers to later administrative long-term follow-up closure.
TRINOVA-1 met its primary PFS endpoint: median 7.2 versus 5.4 months with trebananib versus placebo plus paclitaxel.
Phase 2/3 REACH CDM registered primary CDM1-RS comparison p=0.0514; selected secondary outcomes favored tideglusib.
Published phase 1/2 pilot primarily evaluated safety and tolerability in 30 Alzheimer patients; generally tolerated with reversible liver-enzyme elevations; no efficacy failure is inferred.
ARGO phase 2 publication reported no statistically significant clinical efficacy on its primary Alzheimer outcome.
IMPACTS-2 sickle-cell acute-chest-syndrome prevention study enrolled two participants and ended after a change in company plans; no efficacy result is established.
PLASMA reduced week-8 secretory phospholipase A2 group IIA concentration versus placebo; this biomarker result is not a clinical-event benefit.
FRANCIS-ACS met its week-8 LDL-cholesterol biomarker endpoint with varespladib plus atorvastatin versus placebo plus atorvastatin; clinical-event benefit was not established.
Primary CDR-SB endpoint not met in GRADUATE I.
Primary CDR-SB endpoint not met in GRADUATE II.
Not established; trial terminated after benefit-risk review.
Not established; MISSION AD2 protocol E2609-G000-302 is separately documented but its former NCT ID now resolves to the merged MISSION AD1 registry record.
Primary efficacy interpretation limited by early treatment termination; later analyses reported cognitive worsening rather than benefit.
Not an independent efficacy failure; long-term safety extension terminated with the atabecestat program.
No statistically significant exacerbation reduction after multiplicity adjustment in LUSTER-1.
No statistically significant exacerbation reduction after multiplicity adjustment in LUSTER-2.
ZEAL-1 did not meet its primary pre-dose FEV1 lung-function endpoint.
ZEAL-2 did not meet its primary pre-dose FEV1 lung-function endpoint.
CHROMA: no reduction in geographic atrophy lesion enlargement at week 48 versus sham.
SPECTRI: no reduction in geographic atrophy lesion enlargement at week 48 versus sham.
Long-term study reported some efficacy improvement versus NSAIDs alongside higher joint safety event rates; not an endpoint-failure designation.
Published trial reported efficacy improvements versus placebo and rapidly progressive osteoarthritis in treated groups; not an endpoint-failure designation.
EMBODY 1 did not meet the week-48 BICLA response primary endpoint versus placebo.
EMBODY 2 did not meet the week-48 BICLA response primary endpoint versus placebo.
SIRROUND-D met its ACR20 week-16 and radiographic progression week-52 coprimary endpoints versus placebo.
SIRROUND-T improved week-16 ACR20 response versus placebo; not an endpoint-failure designation.
SYNERGY did not meet its primary multicomponent confirmed-disability-improvement endpoint over 72 weeks; development continued into AFFINITY.
AFFINITY Part 1 missed the prespecified primary and key secondary endpoints; the combined protocol is marked terminated because Part 2 was discontinued after Part 1 results.
SPARK did not meet its year-1 MDS-UPDRS primary endpoint or secondary outcomes; the trial was stopped for lack of efficacy.
PASSPORT did not meet its week-52 PSP Rating Scale primary endpoint; registry reports early closure without a safety concern.
GAMMA-1 completed but did not improve the primary overall-survival endpoint with andecaliximab plus mFOLFOX6.
TANGO missed its prespecified week-78 CDR-SB efficacy endpoint and was terminated for lack of efficacy; the registry's primary listed outcomes concern safety and tolerability.
Tilavonemab PSP study stopped after interim futility criteria; no week-52 PSP Rating Scale benefit was demonstrated.
RAINIER stopped at the prespecified second interim analysis for futility on progression-free survival.
MINDSET did not meet either week-24 ADAS-Cog or ADCS-ADL co-primary endpoint versus placebo.
STARBEAM did not show a significant week-24 ADAS-Cog cognitive benefit versus placebo.
STARBRIGHT did not show a significant week-24 ADAS-Cog cognitive benefit versus placebo.
APECS stopped for futility; verubecestat showed no benefit on the CDR-SB primary clinical outcome versus placebo in prodromal Alzheimer disease.
STABILITY completed without a significant reduction in the primary composite of cardiovascular death myocardial infarction or stroke.
SOLID-TIMI 52 completed without a significant reduction in its primary major-coronary-events composite after acute coronary syndrome.
VISTA-16 terminated after interim review for futility and possible harm; myocardial infarction risk was higher with varespladib.
PROTECT-2 completed; pooled PROTECT analysis with PROTECT-1 showed no significant primary clinical benefit.
